name: routine-watch
description: Your scheduled routines at a glance from a Notion database: today's haul by source, the last 7 days, sources that went quiet and next runs

notion_view_url.title: Notion view URL
notion_view_url.description: Required. The saved view of the database your routines write to, as view://… (ask Claude to fetch the database with the Notion MCP and copy the view URL). Sort the view newest first.

notion_server.title: Notion MCP server
notion_server.description: The name of your Notion MCP server or connector, as /mcp lists it. The mod also tries "notion".

date_property.title: Date property
date_property.description: The date property each row is counted by.

source_property.title: Source property
source_property.description: The property that names where a row came from.

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Comma-separated values of the source property to chart. A source with no rows this week is flagged as possibly broken.

routines.title: Routines
routines.description: Comma-separated Name@HH:MM (24-hour, local time) for each routine's daily run, e.g. Daily Collector@06:00,Writer@21:00. Empty hides the next-run rows.
